channel.title: Willitboard: will your cabin bag fit?
channel.description: Cabin bag limits from each operator's official page, checked by a person.

item.title: Eurostar luggage allowance
item.description: Eurostar publishes a written luggage rule instead of measurements. Read it word for word on Willitboard, with the link to Eurostar's official page and the date a person checked it.

item.title: Volaris cabin bag size and allowance
item.description: Will your bag fit Volaris' cabin limits? Type its size on Willitboard and see in seconds whether it goes at no extra cost, costs extra or doesn't fit. Taken from Volaris' official page and checked by a person, with the date shown on the page.
